import json,re,subprocess,sys
rev=sys.argv[1]
def get(path):
 p=subprocess.run(["git","show",rev+":"+path],capture_output=True,text=True)
 return p.stdout if p.returncode==0 else None
text=get("corpus/knowledge/root-dac-decision-r12.json")
rows={c[0]:c for c in [[x.strip() for x in line.split("|")[1:-1]] for line in get("corpus/SOURCES.md").splitlines() if re.match(r"^\|\s*S\d{3,}\s*\|",line)]}
branches=json.loads(text)["branches"] if text is not None else []
print(sum(all(b.get(k) for k in ["id","evidence","interpretation","discriminator","limit","source_ids"]) and all(s in rows and rows[s][7]=="mined" and "corpus/knowledge/root-dac-decision-r12.md" in rows[s][10] for s in b["source_ids"]) for b in branches))
